GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Pushed fwd to lead on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & boxed on in last 150m. Grabbed late. winkers first time. # Led - tried hard.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.25 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 3 Lengths Two Wide and equal 2nd turning, Held Ground and 3rd place down the running # battled on fairly
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, same approaching 100m, kept on well but headed late # led/kept fighting
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When racing wide in the early stages, was permitted to stride forward and lead the event passing the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, steered into the cutaway and made up a length or So in Straight # never a real threat

A bit slow out then worked up to settled down 4 Lengths Four Wide , worked forward when obvious it was trapped out wide, Moved Up to trail a half length or So Four Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward Settled Down 4th 3 Lengths 600m 5th 4 Lengths home turn 5th Middle Of Track Straight to only hold ground # one paced effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted out, making contact with a runner. Passing the 800m, was carried in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Ridden Along Drifted Back Settled Down 8th Inside 9 Lengths Fast Pace on, Under Pressure 400 couldn't quicken jock gave up @ 200m # did nothing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted out. Rdr reported mount failed to travel comfortably and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Since trailed to Stewards satisfaction.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated he intended leading however it began poorly, was obliged to settle at the rear, required continual encouragement early/middle stages and only ground its way to the line. He added it races best when it can lead and dictate terms and likely did not appreciate the manner in which it was obliged to race. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Ran out across heels on jumping & was steadied. App stated he intended to lead however mount began poorly & was obliged to settle at rear of field. App stated he was required to continually encourage his mount along in e&m stages & it only ground to line down straight. App stated mount races best when it can lead & dictate terms & he does not believe it appreciated the manner in which it was obliged to race today. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, htgt in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 120m, kept trying to post # led/battled on ok

Began fairly. Pushed fwd & led on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured & raced greenly in last 200m but eased clear in last 150m. # Led - won well.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure down the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , moved to within 0.75 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # winner too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay out under pressure down the straight.
